caveats.types: The runs are of different benchmark types.

validation.path: {{label}} must be an absolute path (or start with ~/)
validation.urlScheme: {{label}} must start with http:// or https://
validation.urlCredentials: {{label}} must not contain credentials (use the API key field)
validation.systemPromptBoth: Use either the system prompt text or the system prompt file, not both
validation.pressureBoth: Use either a single context pressure or a sweep, not both
validation.shortAndScenarios: A short run and a specific scenario list cannot be combined
validation.noSuite: Tick at least one suite to run
validation.noPressure: Set a pressure ratio or a sweep range, otherwise this is a plain tool-call run

full.label: Full
full.help: Every standard scenario with the tool's defaults.

hard.label: Hard mode only
hard.help: Only the Hard Mode scenarios (category P).

repro.label: Reproducible
repro.help: Temperature 0 and a fixed seed so repeat runs are comparable.

thinking.label: Thinking model
thinking.help: Disables thinking output and allows 120 s per request (Qwen3 / DeepSeek style).

throughput.quick: Short prompts, one depth, one run per point.

deep.label: Deep context
deep.help: Up to 32k of context and 8 concurrent requests.

specDecode.quick: One prompt type, one run per cell.

code.label: Code and structured
code.help: The prompt types where speculation helps most.

single.label: Single level (75%)
single.help: Core scenarios with the context 75% full.

sweep.label: Sweep 50–100%
sweep.help: Core scenarios at five pressure levels.

accuracy.quick: A small sample of each suite.

regular.label: Regular run
regular.help: The full standard suite: tool selection, parameters, multi-step chains, error recovery, safety and more.

regularHard.label: Regular + Hard mode
regularHard.help: The full suite plus the Hard Mode scenarios.

short.label: Short run
short.help: Only the 15 core scenarios. A fast check after changing a model or setting.

hard.label: Hard mode only
hard.help: Only the adversarial Hard Mode scenarios: stateful, transactional and tricky. For models that ace the regular run.

setup.statusError: Could not check the Tool Eval Bench install
setup.upgradeNote: This runs uv tool upgrade on {{name}}: it fetches the newest tool-eval-bench from GitHub (SeraphimSerapis/tool-eval-bench) and replaces the installed copy. If uv did not install the current copy, it reinstalls from GitHub instead. Tick force reinstall to reinstall from scratch instead.
setup.installNote: This runs uv tool install from GitHub (SeraphimSerapis/tool-eval-bench) on {{name}}, as the user sparkDash connects with.
setup.downloadNote: It downloads Python packages and needs internet access on that Spark. Nothing is installed on the machine running sparkDash.
setup.uvMissingTitle: uv is not installed on this Spark
setup.uvMissingBody: Installation uses uv. Install it first ({{cmd}} on the Spark), then check again.
setup.uvNotFound: uv was not found on the Spark. Install uv first, then try again.
setup.seeOutput: See the output above for the reason (no internet, a missing Python, a full disk…).
setup.notInstalledTitle: Tool Eval Bench is not installed on {{name}}
setup.lead: This page drives the external tool-eval-bench CLI, which runs on the Spark itself. Install it once and every Tool Eval Bench page becomes available. You can still configure and preview a run meanwhile; Start is disabled until it is installed.
setup.unreachable: The Spark could not be reached
setup.newerBody: Latest commit {{latest}}{{date}}; installed {{installed}}. Upgrading runs on {{name}}.
setup.unknownTitle: Could not tell if there is an update
setup.noCommit: The installed version does not name a commit, so it cannot be compared with GitHub.
setup.workDir: Where results live: each run keeps its files under {{dir}} on {{name}}; sparkDash also caches finished results so history stays readable when the Spark is off.
setup.upgradedFromTo: tool-eval-bench on {{name}} went from {{from}} to {{to}}. You can run a benchmark now.
setup.reinstalled: tool-eval-bench on {{name}} was reinstalled and is now {{version}}. You can run a benchmark now.
setup.installedNow: tool-eval-bench {{version}} is installed on {{name}}. You can run a benchmark now.

connection.label: Connection
connection.help: Which model endpoint to test and how to talk to it.

sampling.label: Sampling
sampling.help: How the model generates its answers.

run.label: Run control
run.help: Timeouts, repetitions, concurrency and prompt overrides.

output.label: Output
output.help: Labels and where reports are written.

throughput.label: Throughput benchmark
throughput.help: Prompt processing and generation speed (llama-benchy style).

spec.label: Speculative decoding
spec.help: Effective tokens/s and draft acceptance for speculative / MTP decoding.

pressure.label: Context pressure
pressure.help: Fill the context window before each scenario to find where quality degrades.

needle.label: Needle in a haystack
needle.help: Long-context retrieval at different depths and lengths.

decision.label: Decision model
decision.help: Decision-model scoring on a llama.cpp /v1/systemone endpoint.

base-url.label: Base URL
base-url.help: OpenAI-compatible server URL. Empty = this Spark's LLM port on localhost (the run happens on the Spark itself).

model.label: Model
model.help: Model name or path. Empty = auto-detected from the server.

backend.label: Backend label
backend.help: Label for reports only; the request format follows the endpoint, not this label.

provider.label: Provider
provider.help: Read the endpoint from TOOL_EVAL_<NAME>_BASE_URL / _API_KEY / _MODEL set on the Spark (e.g. openai, gemini, anthropic).

format.label: Wire format
format.help: openai, gemini or anthropic (/v1/messages). Default: detected from the base URL.

api-key.label: API key
api-key.help: Sent to the tool through its environment, never on a command line. Leave empty to use the key saved for this Spark's port (if any).

header.label: Extra request headers
header.help: One NAME=VALUE per line. Values are passed through the environment (they may hold tokens). Semicolons are not allowed in values.

session-header.label: Session header
session-header.help: Header carrying a per-conversation id, e.g. x-opencode-session.

short.label: Short run (core 15)
short.help: Run only the 15 core scenarios (about 2 minutes). Skips the extended and agentic ones.

scenarios.label: Specific scenarios
scenarios.help: Scenario IDs such as TC-01 TC-07. Empty = all.

categories.label: Categories
categories.help: Run only these categories (letters A–P). Empty = all.

hardmode.label: Include Hard Mode
hardmode.help: Add the Hard Mode scenarios (category P): adversarial, stateful, transactional.

hardmode-only.label: Hard Mode only
hardmode-only.help: Run only Hard Mode scenarios (shortcut for --hardmode --categories P).

variant-seed.label: Variant seed
variant-seed.help: Use versioned deterministic fixture variants; unchanged scenarios stay as controls.

scenario-pack.label: Held-out scenario packs
scenario-pack.help: Directory of a YAML scenario pack on the Spark, one per line. Pack prompts are withheld from reports.

pack-only.label: Packs only
pack-only.help: Run only the scenarios from the packs above (skip the public suite).

no-think.label: Disable thinking
no-think.help: Turns off thinking/reasoning (enable_thinking=false). Important for Qwen3 and DeepSeek style models.

seed.label: Seed
seed.help: Random seed passed to the server for reproducible sampling.

backend-kwargs.label: Backend kwargs (JSON)
backend-kwargs.help: A JSON object merged into every API payload; overrides the individual sampling fields.

timeout.label: Request timeout (s)
timeout.help: Per-request timeout. Thinking models may need 120 or more.

trials.label: Trials
trials.help: Repeat the whole run N times for Pass@k statistics.

error-rate.label: Injected tool-error rate
error-rate.help: Randomly inject tool errors (0–1) to test robustness.

no-warmup.label: Skip warm-up
no-warmup.help: Do not send the warm-up request first.

no-preflight.label: Skip model pre-flight
no-preflight.help: Skip the strict model availability check.

no-probe-engine.label: Skip engine probing
no-probe-engine.help: No /version or /health calls to identify the inference engine.

system-prompt.label: System prompt override
system-prompt.help: Replaces the built-in prompt for every scenario (max 32 KiB). Part of the run fingerprint.

system-prompt-file.label: System prompt file
system-prompt-file.help: Path on the Spark to a UTF-8 file (max 32 KiB). Cannot be combined with the text above.

skip-tool-eval.label: Skip tool-call scenarios
skip-tool-eval.help: Use together with throughput or speculative-decoding benchmarks.

resume.label: Resume run
resume.help: Continue an interrupted run by its run id, keeping completed outcomes.

diff.label: Diff against run
diff.help: Compare against a previous run id (or 'latest').

fail-on-safety.label: Fail on safety
fail-on-safety.help: Exit with status 2 when safety-critical scenarios fail.

alpha.label: Quality weight (alpha)
alpha.help: Quality vs speed weight in the deployability score (0–1).

weight-by-difficulty.label: Weight by difficulty
weight-by-difficulty.help: Score harder scenarios more (1× trivial … 5× very hard).

label.label: Label
label.help: Free-form note attached to every report from this run; a slug of it is added to report file names.

output-dir.label: Report directory
output-dir.help: Where report files are written on the Spark (default: the tool's own runs/ folder).

perf.label: Run throughput benchmark
perf.help: Run it before the tool-call scenarios.

benchy-args.label: Extra llama-benchy arguments
benchy-args.help: Pass-through arguments for llama-benchy (one quoted string).

tokenizer.label: Tokenizer path
tokenizer.help: Local tokenizer.json (or its directory) for prompt construction. Needed only on offline hosts.

spec-bench.label: Run speculative-decoding benchmark
spec-bench.help: Effective tokens/s, acceptance rate and tau.

spec-method.label: Method hint
spec-method.help: Used when the server does not identify its method (default: auto).

spec-prompts.label: Prompt types
spec-prompts.help: Comma separated, default filler,code,structured. Labels from your prompt file also work.

spec-prompt-file.label: Custom prompt file
spec-prompt-file.help: One prompt per line, or JSON lines with 'prompt' and an optional 'label'.

baseline-tgs.label: Baseline tokens/s
baseline-tgs.help: Known tokens/s without speculation, for the speedup ratio.

metrics-url.label: Prometheus /metrics URL
metrics-url.help: Needed when the API sits behind a proxy.

context-pressure.label: Pressure ratio
context-pressure.help: Fill the context to this ratio (0–1) before each scenario.

sweep-steps.label: Sweep steps
sweep-steps.help: How many pressure levels to test (default 5).

mmlu-subjects.label: Subjects
mmlu-subjects.help: Comma-separated subjects or categories, e.g. STEM,abstract_algebra.

needle-depths.label: Depths
needle-depths.help: Needle depths to probe, evenly spaced 0–100% (default 5).

needle-lengths.label: Lengths
needle-lengths.help: Haystack sizes up to the context window (default 4).

decision-only.label: Decision only
decision-only.help: Skip the tool-call scenarios and the chat pre-flight.
